evidence.title: Lagrue hired to lead Red Bull Junior Programme in 2027
Why Aston Martin's B-Spec Upgrades Signal a Midfield F1 Revival
evidence.body: [e002:f01] SF Streamline Feed Official Verified Jul 27, 2026 Updated Jul 27, 2026 4 min read Follow on Google News Build your reading streak 0 / 3 today · Counts at 25% The Hungaroring circuit in Budapest is notoriously unforgiving, demanding maximum downforce and exposing the slightest aerodynamic flaw. [e002:f02] Yet, during the Hungarian Grand Prix weekend, it provided the perfect crucible for Aston Martin's heavily anticipated AMR26 B-spec car. [e002:f03] While drivers Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll finished just outside the points on Sunday, securing 13th and 14th place respectively, the underlying telemetry has triggered a wave of optimism inside the paddock. [e002:f04] Aston Martin endured a torrid start to the 2026 Formula 1 season. [e002:f05] Struggling to adapt to the sweeping new aerodynamic regulations and battling unexpected integration issues with their newly supplied Honda power unit, the Silverstone-based outfit languished at the bottom of the Constructors' Championship. [e002:f06] The Hinchcliffe Verdict Former IndyCar Series driver and prominent F1 TV analyst James Hinchcliffe has emerged as a vocal proponent of Aston Martin's resurgence. [e002:f07] "I think they could be regular point scorers by the end of the season," he noted, a significant projection for a team currently holding just a single point. [e002:f08] Deconstructing the AMR26 B-Spec The term "B-spec" is not used lightly in Formula 1. [e002:f09] Aston Martin's engineering team focused their efforts on completely overhauling the floor architecture and redesigning the sidepods to better channel airflow toward the rear diffuser. [e002:f10] Aston Martin sits in 10th place in the Constructors' Championship with exactly one point—salvaged by Alonso at the chaotic Monaco Grand Prix following a flurry of penalties to rival drivers. [e002:f11] While Alonso warned reporters that "no package in the world" instantly erases a multi-second deficit to the front-running McLarens and Red Bulls, the B-spec car has demonstrably closed the gap to midfield rivals like Alpine and Haas. [e002:f12] Global Implications and Kenyan Viewership Aston Martin's battle for midfield supremacy is being watched closely far beyond the European heartland of motorsport. [e002:f13] At popular venues like K1 Klubhouse and across DSTV SuperSport broadcasts, fans heavily dissect midfield battles, which frequently dictate the outcomes of local sports betting markets. [e002:f14] If Hinchcliffe's predictions hold true, Aston Martin will return from the summer break not as backmarkers, but as a formidable disruptive force. evidence.title: Honda brings major update on new F1 engine’s first outing
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Honda will put its updated Formula 1 power unit through its paces this week, ahead of its mooted debut after the summer break. [e003:f02] The Japanese giants have been placed firmly under the microscope amid a so far wretched return to F1, as engine manufacturer to Aston Martin. [e003:f03] Its power unit is significantly slower than that of its rivals, leaving the Silverstone-based squad languishing at the back of the field, having been midfield contenders over the last few seasons. [e003:f04] Having naturally qualified for the Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities [ADUO] scheme as per this year's new technical regulations, Honda has been hard at work to produce a significant amount of extra horsepower. [e003:f05] Aston debuted its own upgrades package in Hungary, the B-spec AMR26 showing some clear improvements through aero changes, which it hopes will be successfully accompanied by the new Honda upgrades. [e003:f06] Speaking after the race at the Hungaroring, its trackside chief, Shintaro Orihara, confirmed that a filming day test, also at the same circuit, will be its debut outing ahead of its scheduled first appearance in Zandvoort. [e003:f07] "In Hungary, we have been supporting the team with the power unit integration," he said. [e003:f08] "We’ve also been able to collect vital data, which will help us come the next race. [e003:f09] "We will now take the important step of introducing our new spec power unit in the Netherlands. [e003:f10] Before then, during Wednesday’s filming day, we will run the new engine in the AMR26 for the first time, before the summer shutdown commences." Shintaro Orihara has confirmed its updated power unit will debut this week Honda hoping for 'laptime gain' from joint upgrades with Aston Martin Whilst Aston failed to score points in Hungary, Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso finished 13th and 14th, a remarkable achievement given the myriad of problems the car has faced since its debut in Melbourne. [e003:f11] Orihara intimated the result was a springboard full of confidence that it will carry into the test, and hopefully, the Dutch Grand Prix, when the two upgrades will jointly run together. [e003:f12] "Now we are back to racing the field," he said. [e003:f13] "Then, all improvement is very important to catch up to others. [e003:f14] To introduce the new power unit in Zandvoort is quite important, now the chassis is working well. [e003:f15] So our power unit should bring some laptime gain." The continuing work rate put in by both Sakira and Silverstone sides of the operation has been remarkable, given its starting point. [e003:f16] And even if Aston fails to score any more points this season, a similar trajectory in performance will be considered a huge result in itself.

evidence.body: [e004:f01] アストンは2台前進のダブル完走 / F1ハンガリーGP 2026《決勝》結果と詳報 Published： 2026/7/27 00:29 Updated： 2026/7/28 11:22 ランド・ノリス（マクラーレン）が、7月26日（日）にハンガロリンクで行われた2026年F1第11戦ハンガリーGPを制し、今シーズン初優勝を挙げた。 [e004:f02] ポール・トゥ・ウインで昨年大会に続く2連覇を達成した。 [e004:f03] 15.080秒差の2位は、4番グリッドからスタートしたマックス・フェルスタッペン（レッドブル）となった。 [e004:f04] 黄旗違反に伴う3グリッド降格によって7番手からスタートしたドライバーズ選手権首位のアンドレア・キミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス）は3位に入り、表彰台を確保した。 [e004:f05] 70周のレース序盤はオスカー・ピアストリ（マクラーレン）が首位を奪い、マクラーレンが1－2体制を築いた。 [e004:f06] Courtesy Of McLaren 優勝を喜び両拳を掲げるランド・ノリス（マクラーレン）、2026年7月26日（日） F1ハンガリーGP決勝（ハンガロリンク） 予選2番手ながらも、Q3でピアストリを妨害したとして3グリッド降格の5番手からスタートしたルイス・ハミルトン（フェラーリ）は5位、不可解なエンジン暴走に見舞われスタート直後に18番手まで後退したジョージ・ラッセル（メルセデス）は7位だった。 [e004:f07] アストンマーティン・ホンダ勢は、ランス・ストロールが13位、フェルナンド・アロンソが14位でダブル完走を果たした。 [e004:f08] 70周のレースは、バーチャル・セーフティーカー（VSC）の導入により、2ストップ戦略と3ストップ戦略が入り混じる展開となった。 [e004:f09] 2026年7月26日(日) F1ハンガリーGP決勝の各ドライバーのピットストップ戦略をまとめたタイヤ使用状況グラフィック（ハンガロリンク） ピアストリ首位奪取も、周回遅れと接触 最前列2番グリッドからスタートしたシャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ）は、オープニングラップで5番手まで後退。 [e004:f10] 開始早々に1－2体制を整えたマクラーレンは、後続のアンダーカットを防ぐべく2台に異なる戦略を採用した。 [e004:f11] ハミルトンはアントネッリの前でコースへ戻ったように見えたが、第2セーフティーカー（SC）ラインを通過した時点ではアントネッリがわずかに前だったため、その後ポジションを譲った。 [e004:f12] 大改良アストン、予選に続きレースでも前進 予選で今季初のQ2進出を果たしたアストンマーティン・ホンダは、決勝でもキャデラック勢、ハース勢、ウィリアムズ勢に加え、アルピーヌの1台を上回り、2台ともが順位を上げた。 [e004:f13] アロンソは第1スティントを36周目まで延ばし、1ストップで走り切る可能性を残した。 [e004:f14] だが、51周目のVSC導入を受け、チームはアロンソに2回目のタイヤ交換を実施。 [e004:f15] キャデラック勢、相次ぐトラブルでダブルDNF キャデラックは、2台ともチェッカーフラッグを受けられなかった。 [e004:f16] 2026年F1第11戦 ハンガリーGP 決勝リザルト Pos No Driver Team Laps Time PTS 1 1 ランド・ ノリス マクラーレン ・メルセデス 70 1:39:56.180 25 2 3 マックス・ フェルスタッペン レッドブル 70 evidence.title: ePlane signs five strategic partnerships for e200X at FIA 2026
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The agreements cover electrical wiring, fasteners, avionics, composite materials, and modular interiors to support the development and certification of the e200X. [e005:f02] The partnerships cover electrical wiring systems, aerospace-grade fasteners, avionics, composite materials, and modular interiors as the company advances the aircraft towards partnership announcements follow two major milestones for The ePlane Company this month. [e005:f03] At the Farnborough International Airshow 2026, the company unveiled PT-01, the first full-scale prototype of its e200X eVTOL aircraft, which is designed for passenger, cargo and emergency medical transport applications. [e005:f04] It also signed a memorandum of understanding with Apollo Hospitals to jointly develop an electric air ambulance network in India, with the aim of reducing emergency response times using eVTOL aircraft. [e005:f05] According to the company, the agreements strengthen the industrial ecosystem supporting the e200X ePlane Company signed a Memorandum of Understanding with SASMOS HET Technologies to collaborate on the engineering, design and industrialisation of Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (EWIS) for the e200X. [e005:f06] The collaboration is intended to progress towards a definitive agreement and is expected to include harness architecture, design for manufacturability, prototype evaluation and certification readiness. [e005:f07] The companies will also explore mission-critical electronic integrated systems, including overhead circuit breaker panels, high-voltage power distribution units, electronic speed controllers and motor company also entered into a strategic partnership with Ankit Aerospace Private Limited to supply aerospace-grade fasteners for the e200X. [e005:f08] The precision-engineered components are designed to support critical aircraft the airshow, The ePlane Company also showcased its ongoing partnership with HENSOLDT Avionics, first announced in February 2026. [e005:f09] HENSOLDT continues to supply the avionics suite and flight radar for the e200X, supporting navigation, situational awareness and connectivity as the aircraft moves towards company has also partnered with Azista Composites to supply composite materials, including carbon fibre prepregs and glass prepregs, for airframe and radome applications. [e005:f10] The partnership also includes the development of material specifications based on the e200X programme's addition, The ePlane Company signed a strategic partnership with AMS Heli Design to explore modular interior and seating solutions for the e200X. [e005:f11] The interiors are intended to support multiple mission configurations, including air ambulance, air taxi, cargo and VIP operations using a single airframe."These partnerships reflect the strength and depth of the ecosystem we're building around the e200X. [e005:f12] From wiring and fasteners to avionics, composites, and interiors, each of these relationships strengthens our path toward a certifiable, Made-in-India electric aircraft," said Satya Chakravarthy, Founder and CTO, The ePlane Company.

evidence.title: Mercedes F1 boss Toto Wolff launches extraordinary 'Teletubbies' rant at rival teams
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Backmarkers getting in the way of the frontrunners was a theme of the race at the Hungaroring, with Williams' Carlos Sainz even making contact with McLaren's Oscar Piastri when he was chasing after a race win. [e001:f02] Traffic got in the way of Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli towards the end of the race too, almost allowing Lewis Hamilton to get by him for third. [e001:f03] Article continues under video It was revealed after the race that there was a fault with the blue flag system which is used by FIA race stewards to tell backmarkers to move out of the way when they are being lapped by faster cars. [e001:f04] When a blue flag is waved or signified via the FIA's light panels, said driver must get out of the way at their earliest convenience, and they will be punished if they fail to do so after being given three warnings. [e001:f05] But the system seemed to be showing even to drivers at the front of the race, with both Lando Norris and Antonelli revealing in the cooldown room that they had been shown blue flags at various points in the race. [e001:f06] Nonetheless, Antonelli's boss Wolff was disappointed with some of the smaller teams' race engineers, slamming them for not telling their drivers when there were faster cars behind. [e001:f07] F1 RESULTS TODAY: Hungarian Grand Prix times and positions Wolff fumes at race engineers Wolff suggested to Sky Sports F1 that some of the race engineers could have been doing a much better job during the Hungarian GP, describing them as 'Teletubbies', while also blasting the backmarkers' refusal to let frontrunners through as 'unacceptable'. [e001:f08] Teletubbies was a British TV programme in the early 2000s aimed at very young children, with four characters known Tinky-Winky, Dipsy, Lala and that resembled toddlers and talked gibberish. [e001:f09] When Antonelli approached a gaggle of cars towards the end of the race, it was four drivers who were scrapping over the last couple of points-paying positions, which potentially led to them not wanting to yield as easily to the faster cars coming through. [e001:f10] "The cars in the back defending is just not acceptable and not good enough from us," Wolff said. [e001:f11] "And you know, then the marshalling system not functioning. [e001:f12] And cars in the back defending from Lewis and Kimi. [e001:f13] "I just find disgraceful from some of the Teletubbies engineers that sit on the pit walls of these teams, not telling the drivers what's happening behind. [e001:f14] "And so, overall, a day I'm just, I'm just not happy about the whole situation.

evidence.body: [e002:f01] 問題は確かに安全性だったが、純粋な運転技術も関係しており、電気エネルギーの配分管理の重要性に比べると、運転技術は時に後回しにされがちだった。 [e002:f02] これらの苦情は、様々な関係者から提起された些細な問題（スタート手順、予選で消費されるエネルギー量など）をさらに悪化させ、積み重なり始めていた。 [e002:f03] 中東グランプリの中止という不運に見舞われたものの、FIAは思わぬ幸運を見出した。 [e002:f04] 一連の会議を経て、月曜日にFIA、FOM、チーム、エンジンメーカーの間でビデオ会議が行われ、最終的に決定が下されました。 [e002:f05] 最大許容充電電力は8 MJから7 MJに削減され、スーパークリッピング時間を1周あたり4秒から2秒に短縮することを目指しています。 [e002:f06] なお、日本グランプリの予選前には、充電電力はすでに9 MJから8 MJに削減されていましたが、それでもドライバーがフルスロットルで1周を完走するには不十分でした。 [e002:f07] セキュリティの強化、特に開始時 レースに関しては、鈴鹿でのベアマンのクラッシュにつながった過度な速度差を避けるため、ブーストの最大出力は150kWに制限される。 [e002:f08] 最後に、グリップとパフォーマンスを向上させるため、ウェットコンディション時の中間タイヤウォーマーの温度が上昇しました。 [e002:f09] これらの変更はすべて、世界モータースポーツ評議会の投票を経て、5月1日から3日に開催される選手権第4戦マイアミグランプリから適用されます。 [e002:f10] この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する F1 27/07/2026 17:20 エステバン・オコンはついにハースのハンドルを握り、喜びを噛み締めた。 [e002:f11] 」 平等に読む F1 27/07/2026 16:30 2026年F1世界選手権 – ハンガリーGP終了時点の順位 F1 27/07/2026 15:37 元 F1 および耐久レースドライバー、フィリップ・アリオが 73 歳の誕生日を祝います。 [e002:f12] F1 27/07/2026 14:41 グウェン・ラグルーは2027年に正式にレッドブルに加入する予定です。 [e002:f13] [email protected] 😉🧐 A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 22/04/26 F1 2026は、少なくともレギュレーションの面では大惨事であるという点では、皆同意するでしょう👎。 [e002:f14] ドライバーがコントロールしなければなりません...😎👀🧐 アラン・フェグエンヌ F1コンペティションズ – ル・マン24時間レース – WEC D ドチェズ 22/04/26 そうそう、F1ドライバーは才能に加えて「コンピュータープログラマー」としての能力も必要になるんだ… C CBP 22/04/26 彼らはこんな馬鹿げたことをやめるべきだ。 [e002:f15] v ヴァンサン・モエ 21/04/26 ル・マンとFIAは高速道路のような直線コースでの人工的な追い越しをなかなか手放そうとしないようだが、これは正しい方向への一歩と言えるだろう。 [e002:f16] Y イヴ・アンリ・ランディエ 21/04/26 リバティ・メディアとFIAのコンビは、様々な関係者の意見に耳を傾けるという現実的な姿勢を示しており、これは既に良い兆候と言えるでしょう。

evidence.title: メルセデスがグウェン・ラグルーの退団を発表
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 数日前から、グウェン・ラグルーの将来についての噂が流れていた。 [e003:f02] 彼女はそれまで、 メルセデス チームは7月27日（月）に、50歳のフランス人監督を解任した。 [e003:f03] 君と一緒の冒険は素晴らしいものだった。 [e003:f04] 私たちは共に、現在のパイロットたちを含め、多くの若いパイロットを育成してきた。 [e003:f05] 」 F1 ジョージ（ラッセル）とキミ（アントネッリ）、そしてあなたは、素晴らしい貢献をしてくれました。 [e003:f06] 私たちは、初代メルセデス・ベンツ・ジュニアチームの真の後継者を築き上げ、あなたは才能あふれるチームを残してくれました。 [e003:f07] 彼らはこの仕事を引き継いでくれるでしょう。 [e003:f08] 仕事上の関係は終わっても、私たちは共通のビジョンで結ばれた友人であり続けます。 [e003:f09] これは、現在F1コンストラクターズ世界選手権を制しているチームのソーシャルネットワークで配信されたプレスリリースに記載されている内容です。 [e003:f10] ここ数日、複数の情報源が、グウェン・ラグルーが将来的に（そのチーム／クラブで）プレーする可能性があると示唆している。 [e003:f11] レッドブルレーシング 長年にわたり、オーストリアのチームは若手人材育成の分野でベンチマークとなり、特に セバスチャン·ベッテル , マックスVerstappen または カルロス·サインツ ほんの一例を挙げると、多くのドライバーがF1にステップアップしてきた。 [e003:f12] グウェン・ラグルーは豊富な経験を持ち、レッドブルに新たな活力を与えることができるだろう。 [e003:f13] フランス人のローラン・メキエスが率いるこのチームは、エイドリアン・ニューウェイとヘルムート・マルコの相次ぐ退任、そしてクリスチャン・ホーナーの物議を醸した退任を経て、新たな時代に突入した。 [e003:f14] この記事はあなたにとって興味深いかもしれません F1 27/07/2026 14:00 ランド・ノリス、ブダペストでのチャンピオンズリーグ出場にふさわしい この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する F1 27/07/2026 17:20 エステバン・オコンはついにハースのハンドルを握り、喜びを噛み締めた。 [e003:f15] 」 平等に読む F1 27/07/2026 16:30 2026年F1世界選手権 – ハンガリーGP終了時点の順位 F1 27/07/2026 15:37 元 F1 および耐久レースドライバー、フィリップ・アリオが 73 歳の誕生日を祝います。 [e003:f16] F1 27/07/2026 14:41 グウェン・ラグルーは2027年に正式にレッドブルに加入する予定です。

evidence.title: ヒュンダイとFIAが地域ラリーの促進で提携
evidence.body: [e004:f01] ©ヒュンダイメディア FIAはヒュンダイ・モータースポーツと協力して、今後開催されるi20 Rally2でのWRCラウンドの賞金を獲得して、XNUMXつの主要地域にわたってラリーを宣伝している。 [e004:f02] 名前の下に FIA ラリー チャンピオンズ ワールド ツアー 、国際連盟と連携して ヒュンダイ モータースポーツは、地域レベルのモータースポーツを促進したいと考えています。 [e004:f03] ラリー アフリカ選手権、アジアパシフィック選手権、CODASUR選手権、中東選手権、NACAMラリー選手権のXNUMXつの主要グループに分かれています。 [e004:f04] これらの異なる2021年シリーズの勝者は、報酬として、開発が進められている将来のヒュンダイi2022ラリー20のハンドルを握って、2年の世界ラリー選手権のラウンドを受け取ることができる。 [e004:f05] FIAはさらに、このプログラムが2022年間にわたって実施されることを発表した。 [e004:f06] 2023年とXNUMX年の優勝クルーにも賞の資格があり、イベントに参加することになる。 [e004:f07] WRC 2023年と2024年のシーズン中に。 [e004:f08] 「ヒュンダイ・モータースポーツと提携して開発されたこの取り組みを発表できることを非常にうれしく誇りに思います。 [e004:f09] これはFIA地域ラリー選手権を強化し、全大陸の競技者にとってより魅力的なものにするのに役立ちます。 [e004:f10] FIAラリーボスのイブ・マットンを指す。 [e004:f11] さらに、欧州以外の国籍の競技者がラリーピラミッドの頂点に登るルートを作り出すことで、世界ラリー選手権にさらなる多様性がもたらされ、特に地域のスター選手が世界ラリー選手権の主力イベントに参加するおかげで、ポジティブなメディア報道が生まれるだろう。 [e004:f12] さらに、翌年の i20 Rally2 で世界レベルに到達するチャンスも得られます。 [e004:f13] » オンラインでの WRC シミュレーションと実車の両方で若い才能を発掘することを目的としたラリー スターに続く、FIA の功績が認められる新しい取り組みです。 [e004:f14] この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する ラリー 27/07/2026 09:54 ジュリアン・イングラシアは今週末フィンランドでセバスチャン・オジエとともに復帰する 平等に読む ラリー 24/07/2026 19:00 8月上旬にスコットランドで開催されるグランピアン・フォレスト・ラリーには、非常に豪華な出場選手たちが集結する予定です。 [e004:f15] CFR 27/07/2026 08:36 レハネ・ガニーがツール・オート・ド・ラ・レユニオンでキャリア3勝目を挙げる ERC 26/07/2026 17:56 ERC – ラリー・ポーランド：テーム・スニネンが優勝し、チャンピオンシップのリードをさらに広げる 購読者限定 今週の雑誌 今週号と過去の号をデジタル版で、またはご自宅でご覧ください！ [e004:f16] Acheter S'abonner。

evidence.title: After SpaceX’s Launch, Investors Should Keep an Eye Out for These IPOs
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Less than a week after its record-setting IPO , the stock has gained 24%, making SpaceX — which includes satellite broadband provider Starlink, xAI and rocket launch services — the fifth largest publicly traded company on Earth and paving the way for a flurry of other companies to follow suit later this year. [e001:f02] The uptick comes after a notable decline in the number of IPOs over the past several years. [e001:f03] After a record 1,035 companies went public in 2021, just 181 held IPOs in 2022, marking a nearly 83% year-over-year decrease. [e001:f04] In 2023, that number fell to just 154 IPOs — the lowest since 2016. [e001:f05] But with 171 public listings so far this year, IPOs have taken center stage. [e001:f06] “Since the big pullback in 2022 and ’23, I think [a successful SpaceX IPO] could definitely open the door,” Jennifer Horton, executive vice president at CapWealth, previously told Money . [e001:f07] With data from prediction markets as well as the Nasdaq’s IPO calendar supporting that notion, the following four companies could hold public listings by the end of 2026 as they aim to replicate SpaceX’s successful launch. [e001:f08] OpenAI could be the next mega-cap company to IPO OpenAI, the company behind the large language model (LLM) ChatGPT, announced on June 8 that it had confidentially filed Form S-1 — the legal document required to pursue a public offering — with the U.S. [e001:f09] Like SpaceX, OpenAI is currently operating at a net loss that analysts expect to reach $14 billion by the end of 2026. [e001:f10] OpenAI is projected to reach profitability around 2029, but because the company is private and its S-1 hasn’t yet been made publicly available, prospective investors will have to wait to evaluate financial disclosures. [e001:f11] According to a press release , the LLM provider has not decided on the timing of its IPO . [e001:f12] The company, which develops LLMs and advanced AI assistants — the most popular of which are in the Claude family of models — filed its S-1 on June 1. [e001:f13] In a press release , Anthropic hedged against specific expectations, stating that the S-1 filing “gives us the option to go public after the SEC completes its review… [but] the proposed initial public offering will depend on market conditions and other factors.” However, the company is proceeding cautiously. [e001:f14] “The government has to do its part as well… but the onus primarily falls on us.” On May 28, Anthropic closed a funding round that raised $65 billion, bringing its valuation to $965 billion , or 13% higher than Sam Altman-led OpenAI. [e001:f15] Kraken paused its plans for an IPO due to the bear market despite confidentially filing its S-1 with the SEC in November 2025. evidence.title: SpaceX Statistics 2026: Launches, Starlink, Revenue & Contracts
evidence.body: [e002:f01] LATEST POSTS: OpenAI Brings ChatGPT Voice to the Desktop App Anthropic Adds Model Choice to Claude Voice Mode For All Users OpenAI Opens ChatGPT Health to All US Users Amid Lawsuit As Featured In SpaceX flew 165 orbital missions in 2025, another annual launch record and roughly 85% of the United States’ total tally for the year, according to tracking of the launch manifest. [e002:f02] Below: launch cadence, booster reusability, Starship progression, Starlink subscribers, Crew Dragon, market share, contracts, and corporate metrics. [e002:f03] Key Takeaways SpaceX recorded 165 orbital launches in 2025, up from 134 in 2024 and 25 in 2020, a sixfold increase in five years. [e002:f04] Starlink’s average revenue per subscriber fell 18% to $81 per month in 2025, down from approximately $99 per month in 2023, according to The Information. [e002:f05] SpaceX’s 2025 revenue is projected at around $15.5 billion (per Elon Musk) with about $8 billion in profit, according to Bloomberg and Reuters reporting, with Starlink driving 50-80% of sales. [e002:f06] Editor’s Choice 165 SpaceX launches in 2025, another annual record. [e002:f07] April 1, 2026 : SpaceX confidentially filed for an IPO targeting a valuation above $2 trillion , after a December 2025 secondary at roughly $800 billion . [e002:f08] Recent Developments April 29, 2026 : Falcon Heavy returned to flight after an 18-month hiatus on its 12th mission, carrying the ViaSat-3 F3 satellite from Launch Complex 39A. [e002:f09] March 17, 2026 (approx.): Starlink crossed 10,000 active satellites in orbit, according to Jonathan McDowell’s tracking, after a Vandenberg launch deployed 25 satellites. [e002:f10] March 24, 2026 : SpaceX closed a Series J funding round; by that point, cumulative funding across 32 rounds reached $11.9 billion from 240 investors. [e002:f11] SpaceX Annual Launch Cadence Annual launches grew from 25 in 2020 to 31 in 2021, 61 in 2022, 96 in 2023, 134 in 2024, and 165 in 2025, according to tracking of the SpaceX manifest. [e002:f12] Of the 165 Falcon family launches in 2025, 123 carried Starlink satellites. evidence.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 launches Starlink satellites from West Coast
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Liftoff from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California occurred at 8:51 a.m. [e005:f02] The Falcon 9 look a southerly trajectory on departure from Space Launch Complex 4E, as it targeted an 97-degree inclination orbit. [e005:f03] The Falcon 9 first stage booster, launching for an eighth time, touched down on the droneship, ‘Of Course I Still Love You’, stationed about 380 miles downrange in the Pacific Ocean. [e005:f04] The booster, B1100, previously launched the NROL-105 mission for the US government spy satellite agency and six previous Starlink missions. [e005:f05] SpaceX confirmed a successful deployment of the 24 Starlink V2 Mini satellites from the Falcon 9 second stage into a 168 x 160-mile orbit just over an hour into the mission. [e005:f06] The Starlink 17-51 mission was the seventh of eight planned Falcon 9 launches this month from Vandenberg. [e005:f07] SpaceX’s West Coast pad has become the company’s workhorse launch facility in recent months as it focuses on Starship preparations in Florida. previous_updates.summary: SpaceXがIPO投資家へ示した軌道データセンター構想について、地政学アナリストのPeter Zeihanは、1GW施設の組み立てにStarship約500回の打ち上げが必要と試算した。 宇宙では放射線遮蔽とGPUの排熱が課題となり、Wood Mackenzieは1GW施設の総費用を約1700億ドル、地上設備の約3倍と見積もった。 予測市場では1MWの軌道データセンターが2029年1月までに稼働する確率を14％と評価する。 SpaceXは地上側ではAnthropicと月額12億5000万ドルの計算能力契約を結んでいる。

evidence.title: SpaceX Stock Hammered After Starship Booster Fails in First Launch Since IPO
evidence.body: [e003:f01] By Frank Landymore Published Jul 27, 2026 2:19 PM EDT Add Futurism (opens in a new tab) Illustration by Tag Hartman-Simkins / Futurism. [e003:f02] Many are hailing it as a victory, but several of the megarocket’s booster’s engines failed after re-entry, causing it to explode. [e003:f03] SpaceX has had many similarly ambiguous tests before. [e003:f04] But this was the first one since its much-hyped IPO earlier this summer — and it’s already clear that it wasn’t a convincing enough display to reverse the company’s fortunes on the stock market. [e003:f05] After hitting an all time low before the weekend and closing at $115, SpaceX shares endeavored to plummet even further on Monday, briefly dipping to $108.66 — a new nadir since going public — before stabilizing around $110. [e003:f06] The new low is over 20 percent below its opening IPO price of $135, and less than half of its all time high of more than $225 per share. [e003:f07] When Starship ran into trouble in the past, SpaceX mainly had to weather a storm of media coverage. [e003:f08] “One of the benefits of being private is that there wasn’t a market to weigh in on and evaluate business decisions,” David Meier, senior investment analyst at the Motley Fool , told The Washington Post . [e003:f09] “So every SpaceX launch, every Starlink decision and every xAI decision will be scrutinized by the market.” Spaceflight, at least currently, isn’t an ideal match for the make-a-quick-buck capitalism that Musk extolls. [e003:f10] Meanwhile, Musk has made outrageously lofty promises that SpaceX will eventually use Starship to deploy so many data centers in space that it’d create a “sentient sun,” and establish colonies on the Moon and eventually Mars. [e003:f11] This was a first for Starship, as previous tests only used dummies. [e003:f12] Instead of making a planned “soft” splashdown, it slammed into the Gulf of Mexico and appeared to explode on impact . [e003:f13] In the first V3 flight test in May, the upper stage lost several of its engines on its way to space, and this time it didn’t. [e003:f14] The upper stage also survived the splash down instead of exploding, with SpaceX engineers calling it Starship’s best reentry yet . [e003:f15] “The future of the company is riding on the ability to make Starship work,” Clayton Swope, deputy director of the Aerospace Security Project, told WaPo . [e003:f16] “What they’re trying to do is switch to a freight train and get the economies of scale [of] something of that magnitude.” More on SpaceX: SpaceX Investors in Meltdown Over All the Money They’ve Lost。

evidence.title: テスラのロボタクシー スペースXの「Starlink V5」搭載へ 統合への布石か
evidence.body: [e004:f01] テスラは7月20日、宇宙開発企業スペースX（SpaceX）の衛星通信サービスStarlink（スターリンク）の最新アンテナ「V5」をCybercabへ直接組み込むと、公式X（旧Twitter）で図解つきで発表した。 [e004:f02] 通信速度は375Mbps超とされる。 [e004:f03] ただしテスラは、この衛星通信が自動運転の走行そのものに使われるわけではないと説明する。 [e004:f04] 「なぜ自動運転タクシーに宇宙のインターネットが必要なのか」。 [e004:f05] 業界にそんな疑問が広がる一方、スペースXの新規株式公開を前にした、テスラとスペースXの統合への布石だとの見方も出ている。 [e004:f06] リースナブル （車のカーリース） お好きな車が月1万円台！ [e004:f07] パソナキャリア 転職後の平均年収837〜1,015万円 タクシーアプリDiDi クーポンが充実！ [e004:f08] リースナブル 新車が月々2万円から！ [e004:f09] 「乗車無料」チャンス ■Cybercabに載る「Starlink V5」 テスラは7月20日、公式Xで「Starlink V5 directly integrated in Cybercab」と題した図解を投稿し、自動運転タクシーCybercabにStarlinkの最新アンテナを直接組み込む方針を明らかにした。 [e004:f10] このStarlinkを手がけるのは、イーロン・マスク（Elon Musk）氏が率いるスペースXである。 [e004:f11] スペースX側も「自動運転車の未来へ、宇宙からの高速インターネットを」と呼応する投稿をした。 [e004:f12] 搭載されるのは最新世代のアンテナ「V5」だ。 [e004:f13] 従来のV4より大幅に小型で軽く、消費電力も抑えられている。 [e004:f14] ただし、この統合は現行の量産車にすでに搭載されているものではなく、より多くの通信量が必要になる将来に備えて確定させた設計だと説明されている。 [e004:f15] テスラの車が、単なる移動手段ではなく常時ネットにつながる端末へと近づく一歩と言える。 [e004:f16] テスラは車を移動手段ではなく、常時つながる端末として設計し始めている。

evidence.title: Ukraine's new remote turret trades heavy machine gun for twin AK-74s and relies on Starlink when signal drops
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The Ukrainian company Roboneers completed codification of its "ShaBlya K-2" remote-controlled combat module, meaning the turret is ready for official supply to units of Ukraine's Defense Forces, per [Oboronka](https:// The K-2's design is two AK-74 rifles in one paired mount, which doubles fire density and provides reliable cover for infantry at close range. [e001:f02] The ShaBlya has been one of Ukraine's most effective remote turrets since 2014, letting troops hold defensive lines and engage enemy personnel and light targets from cover The operator chooses the firing mode based on the tactical situation: the left rifle, the right, or both at once in a volley. [e001:f03] It is the newest variant of the ShaBlya, one of Ukraine's oldest and most proven remote turrets, developed by a volunteer group in 2014 and [in service](https:// since, with the earlier ShaBlya M2 mounting heavy machine guns on the Ironclad combat robot. [e001:f04] Codification opens the path to serial supply and scaling onto the Defense Forces' platforms. ##### Two rifles trade caliber for volume of fire The twin-AK design is a specific tactical choice. [e001:f05] Where the earlier ShaBlya mounts a single 7.62mm or 12.7mm machine gun, the K-2 pairs two 5.45mm AK-74 rifles, trading the heavier round for the ability to put more bullets downrange from a compact, cheap mount. [e001:f06] A remote turret firing two rifles can pin an approaching enemy or cover a withdrawal at short distance without any soldier exposing themselves to return fire, and the volley mode doubles the suppressive output at the moment it matters. [e001:f07] The AK-74 is also the rifle Ukraine has in the greatest abundance, making ammunition and spares trivial to supply, unlike the belt-fed machine guns the heavier ShaBlya variants use. ##### Three cameras and a Starlink link The K-2 carries the sensors a remote gunner needs to fight without directly seeing the target. [e001:f08] It has a three-camera observation system: a wide-angle day camera for reconnaissance and surveying terrain, a narrow-angle day camera for aimed fire, and a thermal camera for working at night and in limited visibility. [e001:f09] Its connectivity is built for flexibility. [e001:f10] The turret operates via both a cable and a Starlink satellite link, and Roboneers describes it as a network-independent, self-contained unit that integrates easily onto ground platforms. [e001:f11] Its power system includes a built-in backup source and can run from a ground robotic complex or an external battery in the 20-to-60-volt range, letting the module be mounted on different types of platforms. [e001:f12] Ukraine's combat robots and remote systems live or die by their control link, and keeping ground platforms [connected](https:// through terrain, tree lines, and Russian jamming is the hardest part of fielding them. [e001:f13] A turret that can fall back from cable to Starlink is built with that fragility in mind. ## Read Also * ### [Kyiv police detain journalist investigating corruption over draft violation, which his newsroom says doesn’t exist](https:// * ### [Lithuania proposes to implement special test for Russian and Belarusian artists and academics who enter state. evidence.title: Milei announces Starlink deal to bring satellite internet to 6,000 rural schools
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The announcement was made on Sunday during the main event of the 138th International Livestock, Agriculture and Industry Exhibition in Buenos Aires. [e002:f02] According to the president, Elon Musk's company will donate 6,000 complete satellite kits along with 24 months of its highest-capacity service, which includes priority access of up to five terabytes per month per site. [e002:f03] “Yes, it's a huge amount. [e002:f04] Thank you, Elon,” he said during the speech. [e002:f05] Once that period ends, the equipment will remain at the schools and the regulator will take on the cost of the service for an additional year, covering the subscription, installation, technical support, and monitoring. [e002:f06] Enacom sources said those resources will come from the Universal Service Fund, made up of contributions from the telecommunications sector and earmarked for extending access to areas not covered by commercial provision. [e002:f07] At the time of the announcement, neither the text of the agreement nor any public statement from the company about its terms had been released. [e002:f08] The president also said the initiative adds to the three million users who, he said, already use the company's services in the country. [e002:f09] Starlink accelerated its expansion in Argentina following the easing of the regulatory framework for satellite services introduced by the current government, and now operates across the entire territory. [e002:f10] The Argentine market accounts for about 25% of the company's Latin American operation and ranks among the countries with the highest service penetration, with weekly user growth of around 2%. [e002:f11] The agreement fits into the relationship Milei has maintained with Musk since the start of his term. [e002:f12] The two met in February 2025 in the United States and have kept in frequent contact since. [e002:f13] In parallel, Tesla is advancing its commercial entry into the local market, after formally incorporating in the country and appointing its first manager for Argentina and Uruguay. [e002:f14] In the same speech, the president projected an expansion of agricultural output and said the country is in a position to double its grain harvest, though he announced no decisions on export duties, one of the sector's main demands. [e002:f15] Categories: Investments , Politics , Argentina , International , United States . [e002:f16] elon musk , Javier Milei , Starlink .

previous_updates.title: SpaceX、Vandenbergで2026年50回目の打ち上げ
previous_updates.summary: Vandenbergでは7月1日と10日にもFalcon 9によるStarlink打ち上げが行われ、7月21日の飛行がカリフォルニア州で2026年50回目の打ち上げとなった。 別のStarlinkミッションはエンジン点火後に直前中止となったが、SpaceXは機体とペイロードが安全だと説明した。 当初の離昇予定は米東部時間7時49分だった。

evidence.title: SpaceX launches Falcon 9 from Vandenberg Space Force Base
evidence.body: [e003:f01] A Falcon 9 carrying 24 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit lifted off Saturday morning from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E). [e003:f02] UPDATE: Liftoff occurred shortly after 8:50 a.m.—ORIGINAL STORY: SpaceX is gearing up for an early weekend launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base.A Falcon 9 carrying 24 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit is set for liftoff at 7 a.m. [e003:f03] Saturday, the start of the four-hour launch window, from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E).Following stage separation, the booster, which has been used 7 previous times, primarily on Starlink missions, is expected to land on a droneship in the Pacific Ocean. [e003:f04] No sonic boom is expected to be heard locally.A live webcast of the launch, which is expected to begin approximately 10 minutes before liftoff, will be up on and X @ launch will mark the 51st overall launch from Vandenberg so far this year.
